target_customer: In 2022, finance teams using spreadsheets; by 2024, B2B sales teams sending outbound email
problem: In 2022 Flike offered version control and collaboration for spreadsheets, pitched as GitHub for spreadsheets. By 2024 it offered an AI sales co-pilot that learns from a user's Gmail and drafts personalized outbound emails.
business_model: SaaS with a 7 day free trial and Pro, Growth and Enterprise plans (2024)
product_category: Spreadsheet versioning, later AI sales email assistant

founders.name: Tobias Müller
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page; bio says building Supply Chain AI. Third party page names him CEO.

founders.name: Yannick Müller
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page; posted the YC launch. Bio mentions machine learning and web development.

exit.reason: Asset deal reported by a third party citing a FirstQuadrant press release; price undisclosed

technical_complexity.rationale: Spreadsheet version control layered on Google Sheets and Excel needs diffing and sync; the AI sales product used a relevancy engine with many data inputs per prospect, per the YC launch post.

defensibility.rationale: The AI email product competed with funded players such as Lavender and Regie.ai and needed no proprietary data, per the launch post description and a third party analysis.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied the 2022 idea in sources found. FirstQuadrant, a YC backed AI sales company, acquired Flike's assets in June 2024 per one third party page.

market_need_then: A third party page reports Flike's March 2022 pre-seed with angels from Google, GitHub, Airtable and others, and a Forbes piece on the launch. The founder published a product market fit case study in April 2022 per the same page. Direct customer or revenue evidence was not found.

identity.logo: not described in any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Product led: AI crafts sales emails that convert, matching brand voice.

branding.community_and_virality: A Product Hunt launch in February 2024 with 85 reviews at 4.8 per a third party page; no merch or fan activity found.

brand_strength.rationale: A short coinage that is easy to confuse with Flick, Fliki and Flik products, with the original spreadsheet meaning lost after two pivots.

pivots.why: Not stated; third party page says exact dates are unknown.

pivots.to: AI sales co-pilot for outbound email
pivots.why: Not stated; launched on Product Hunt in February 2024.

outcome_analysis: Flike raised about 1.6 million dollars in March 2022 for spreadsheet version control, pivoted twice, and by 2024 sold an AI sales email co-pilot in a crowded field. A third party page reports an asset sale to FirstQuadrant in June 2024 with undisclosed price and no later round found. The failure factor pivot_failed follows that page's reading, not a company statement.
notes: The website fetch returned HTTP 402 so its state is unknown. The acquisition and the 1.6M pre-seed rest on one aggregator (dead-startups) that cites a FirstQuadrant press release, Forbes March 22 2022 and LinkedIn; those primary pages were not opened. CB Insights and Seedtable also show 1.6M in March 2022, while VCBacked and Extruct show 500K; total funding of 2.1M is reported with the remaining 0.5M undocumented. A third party page names Henrik Laxhuber as a third co-founder; not listed because no YC or company source says so. YC launch post names only Yannick Muller. Founder education and employers not found. No competitor with a source dated near the batch was found for the spreadsheet product; Lavender and Regie.ai were named only by a 2024 summary and a 2023 TechCrunch piece, after the batch.
